leadText:
Pikachu Land (Japanese: ピカチュウランド Pikachu Land) is an -exclusive location in the Kalos region. It is a film set found in between Laverre City and Dendemille Town. It is owned by Frank, a movie director, and the location for his movie, .

In Lights! Camera! Pika!, and passed Pikachu Land on their way to Dendemille Town. They noticed a large group of dancing there and decided to check it out. There they met Frank and his granddaughter Jean, and decided to assist Frank in filming his movie called Lightning Fast! Brave and Strong! Super-Pikachu!. In the movie, Pikachu Land is a peaceful town inhabited only by Pikachu.
